items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I remember another band I played with after I got there was DeShon Joe O. Shans

ctx.x: And St. Louis, incidently, and Kansas City, were known jazz meccas. They were the known headquarters in the midwest for excellent jazz players. Many bands -- and
I remember another band I played with after I got there was DeShon Joe O. Shans, and they played all kinds of orchestrations. They were really professional musicians.
